items.reason: A gentle, fragrance-free style cleanser with no actives keeps young skin clean without stripping it.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily sun protection is the one product that really helps skin at this age.

response.routine_note: Retinol, vitamin C and strong peels like the 30% one aren't suitable for children under 13, so I've left them out; the scan scores look healthy, so a simple wash and daily sunscreen is plenty. If you have skin concerns, please check with a parent or guardian and a dermatologist before trying anything else.
